I wrote the delivery report for `greeting-release` at `.feature-flow/greeting-release/delivery.md`. The run's plan has no way to undo the database change, so read the rollback section before you deploy.

**Rollback gap:** the change that adds the required `locale` column to `users` (plan Task 2) has no undo step in the plan's rollback section. To reverse it you would need either a script that removes the column again or a restore from a backup taken before the deploy. The report flags this, and its deployment checklist starts by taking that backup.

The run was finished (`done`) and on the full tier, and no delivery report existed yet, so nothing was overwritten. The run has no durable path set, so the report stayed in the run folder.

| Section | Source | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Release notes | `spec.md`, both acceptance criteria | Two bullets: the `--greeting` flag and the new `locale` column. No decision record is linked in the manifest, so there's no "why" |
| Deployment checklist | Generic list, based on the migration task and the commands verify ran | Deploy off-peak → back up the DB → apply `003_add_locale.sql` → deploy `src/cli.js` → run the checks below |
| Rollback checklist | `plan.md` §Rollback plan, row for row | Task 1: `git checkout -- src/cli.js`. Task 2: flagged as having no undo |
| Migration notes | `plan.md` Task 2 and §Risk register | `003_add_locale.sql` may lock `users` on large tables; run it off-peak. No way to reverse it is defined |
| Known issues | `verify.md` §Limitations, copied as written | Existing rows default to `locale = 'en'`, with no backfill from user settings |
| Release validation | `verify.md` §Commands run | Re-run `node src/cli.js --greeting hi`. The migration command isn't repeated on production; instead, check the `locale` column exists |

In `manifest.json`, the delivery phase is now `complete` and both it and `artifacts.delivery` point to the report. `updatedAt` is updated and `currentPhase` is still `done`.
